idea-plugin.name: Anthropic Chat
idea-plugin.description:
Anthropic Chat is a simple chat tool window backed by the Anthropic Messages API, or by any provider speaking OpenAI's Chat Completions or Responses API — OpenAI, Azure, Microsoft Foundry, OpenRouter, or a local vLLM or Ollama server.

Set the AI_API_KEY environment variable to your API key and restart the IDE, then chat from the tool window. Model, endpoint, API protocol and MCP servers are configured under Settings | Tools | Anthropic Chat.
